==Overview==
E Section Invasion Event was an event that started 08/17/25 and has ended at 09/20/25.. The event was about surviving 2 invaders: [[E-10]] and [[E-60]], surviving it the player would be awarded with the [https://www.roblox.com/badges/3124983362195746/Sector-Breach| Sector Breach] Badge that would give '''Experimental Flashlight''', that is triple of the normal flashlight's battery life but need 5 batteries to fully recharge. It also has a Shakable/Radiant Variant.

==Trivia==
* Both [[E-10]] and [[E-60]] had a 1 in 2500 chance to spawn at the start of the event, the rarity was bought down as the event went on, the chances were:
** 1 in 2500 (Start of Event)
** 1 in 2000 (5 Days Left)
** 1 in 1750 (3 Days Left)
** 1 in 1600 (Last Day)
** 1 in 1500 (Final 4 Hours)
** 1 in 1350 (Final Hour)
** 1 in 690 (Final Minute)
* [[E-60]] got his design changed mid-event
